judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on the anonymized delivery; one matching judge for the delivery, who also read the digest of the rulings applied to the published deliveries of the instance; the EXPL score by a separate blind judge that read only the report and the rubric

planted.report_excerpt: $busca vem de $_GET['busca'] e é concatenado em LIKE '%...%' sem escape; ' UNION SELECT ... lê qualquer tabela (inclui hashes md5 de usuarios).
planted.rationale: F1 at lib.php:80-85 (planted :82), seguranca. The quote break-out and the UNION read are the real mechanism. The fix is a mysqli prepared statement with bind_param (delivered lib.php:78-82), and addcslashes escapes %, _ and \, which the matrix note asks for; probe corrigida=true. Escaping the wildcards is not COMP-003 (rulings B).

planted.report_excerpt: $busca é impresso cru no atributo value e em 'Resultados para:'; "><script> executa no navegador.
planted.rationale: F4 at index.php:79-82 names both output points and the attribute break-out. The fix is htmlspecialchars($busca, ENT_QUOTES) in the value attribute (delivered index.php:89) and htmlspecialchars($busca) in the text node (:92). The declared HTML structure is unchanged.

planted.report_excerpt: Títulos iniciados por =,+,-,@ são gravados crus e podem executar fórmulas no Excel.
planted.rationale: F14 at lib.php:138-144 (planted :140), seguranca, states the real mechanism. It was deliberately not fixed ('prefixar mudaria o conteúdo consumido por scripts do ISP'): titulo still goes raw to fputcsv (delivered lib.php:139), and the probe says corrigida=false. C3 none makes C5 none, with no penalty (rulings A8).

planted.report_excerpt: Session id não é regenerado após login (fixation); cookie sem HttpOnly/SameSite; $_POST['login'][]=x causa TypeError (string tipada) em autenticar.
planted.rationale: F10 at index.php:15-22, seguranca; the planted line :24 is within ±10. F10 bundles three items, but its title, mechanism, impact and fix all lead with the missing session regeneration, so it maps here; the cookie flags and the array TypeError are extras. The mechanism is terse but real: the session id survives the login, which is fixation. session_regenerate_id(true) is called right after a successful autenticar (delivered index.php:25).

planted.report_excerpt: md5($senha) comparado direto no SQL; coluna CHAR(32) impede hash moderno sem migração de schema. [...] Vazamento do banco (ver F1) permite quebra imediata por rainbow table.
planted.rationale: F7 at lib.php:15 ('Senhas com MD5 sem sal') explains the fast unsalted hash and rainbow-table cracking after a leak. It was deliberately not fixed: autenticar still hashes with md5, and only a comment was added (delivered lib.php:15). C3 none, C5 none.

planted.report_excerpt: Senha de produção do banco como fallback de getenv e chave SMTP literal no repositório.
planted.rationale: F9 at config.php:12-15 covers both secrets and recommends rotation. It was deliberately not fixed: config.php is byte-identical to the package, with the DB_PASS literal fallback and the SMTP key literal both kept. C3 none, as for A, P and Q (rulings A8), and C5 none.

planted.report_excerpt: index.php?ver=<id> chama verChamado sem comparar usuario_id com a sessão; $papel era lido e nunca usado.
planted.rationale: F2 at index.php:52-53 is the IDOR on the detail route. The dispatcher now checks after loading: a non-technician who does not own the ticket gets the same 'Chamado nao encontrado.' as for a missing id, and technicians see every ticket (delivered index.php:58-60). verChamado(mysqli,int) is unchanged. The visibility work brings no COMP: mediaResposta stays global, and the listing and CSV are filtered for clients while technicians and sessionless callers still get every ticket (enforcement, rulings B).

planted.report_excerpt: Sem chamados com minutos_resposta, $soma / $qtd lança DivisionByZeroError (PHP 8) e derruba a listagem inteira
planted.rationale: F8 at lib.php:107-117 (planted :116), bug, with the correct PHP 8 behaviour. The fix computes AVG() in SQL and returns 0.0 when it is NULL (delivered lib.php:106-108); probe corrigida=true. AVG gives 25.6667 against 25.666666666666668 on the seed, over the same tickets: inside the tolerance, and the page still shows 26, so it is not COMP-003 (rulings B: C, F, Q).

planted.report_excerpt: Grava em EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv e relê; requisições concorrentes se sobrescrevem (usuário A pode receber dados de B, agravado por F3), fopen sem @ gera warning, retornos antecipados deixam fp aberto e a resposta vazia, arquivo com dados fica em disco.
planted.rationale: The leak is named precisely ('retornos antecipados deixam fp aberto'), at the right place (F5, lib.php:125-150, planted :133) and under the right category. It is only the third of four sub-items of F5, though, and F5 is about the fixed shared export file and its race. Rulings A3 gives C1 half to a flaw named only inside a race finding, and C2 full when the sentence is right. Under A4, a race finding that states the mechanism maps to the row. The export now runs the query first, then streams to php://output with a single fclose and no early return (delivered lib.php:117-146), so the leak path is gone: C3 full. Streaming instead of writing the on-disk file is not COMP (rulings B), and the headers_sent() guard only skips the headers and never throws (unlike CR).

planted.report_excerpt: Para cada chamado uma query extra em usuarios; no export idem.
planted.rationale: F6 at lib.php:64-93 (planted :89) covers the listing and the export loop. listarChamados and exportarCsv each use one LEFT JOIN usuarios with COALESCE(t.nome, '-') (delivered lib.php:75-76, 119-120), so '-' is kept for a ticket with no technician and there is no PEN-001 as in W and AN; probe corrigida=true. Attributed once, per the matrix note.

No finding or non-change names the dispatcher that mixes routing, authorization, rules and HTML. The Decisões item 'Filtro de visibilidade feito em index.php' explains where the filter went, not the smell (rulings A5: the entry must name the smell). index.php still does everything, now with more inline authorization (delivered index.php:46-50, 58-60, 81-83).

Magic numbers are never named. The Decisões entry on formatarStatus is about its 'Resolvido' fallback, not about loose numbers. F13 (arquitetura, lib.php:56-58) describes a label rule, not literals (rulings A4, A5). Status 1/2 and priority 3/4/30 are still literals (delivered lib.php:28-30, 45-51).

planted.report_excerpt: Cinco níveis de aninhamento para uma tabela de decisão simples. [...] Reescrita com retornos antecipados, mesmos resultados em todas as entradas.
planted.rationale: F12 at lib.php:40-59 (planted :43), qualidade. The explanation is short but specific: a simple decision table buried in nesting that is hard to maintain. Its 'five levels' counts the function body; there are four nested ifs. The function is rewritten with guard clauses (delivered lib.php:42-51). Checked branch by branch, the truth table is unchanged: null minutes, priority below 3, minutes up to 30, and priority 4 against 3 above 30 minutes. R3 full, R4 full.

extra_findings: Listing and CSV visibility (F3, index.php:72-73): the listing and index.php?export=csv returned every ticket to any role. Fixed by filtering the listing in the dispatcher and passing the client's uid to exportarCsv's new optional parameter; technicians and sessionless callers still get every ticket (enforcement, not COMP). It is more than 10 lines from index.php:53, so it is an extra, not SEC-017 (rulings A1).

Shared export file (F5, lib.php:125-150): EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv is a fixed path shared by concurrent exports, so one request can serve another's data. A failed fopen warns, and the full-data file stays on disk. Fixed by streaming to php://output. F5's file-handle sub-item is credited to BUG-004.

Session cookie flags and array login (items bundled in F10): the session cookie had no HttpOnly or SameSite, and login[]=x made autenticar() throw a TypeError (HTTP 500). Fixed with session_set_cookie_params (httponly, SameSite=Lax) and string casts.
SEC-005 class (F11): the login form has no CSRF token, no rate limit and no logout. Reported, not changed.

Priority-4 label (F13, lib.php:56-58): an unanswered priority-4 ticket is labelled 'Aguardando 1a resposta' with no SLA highlight. This is contracted behaviour, it was kept, and the report itself says it may be intentional (rule 14: an extra, not a false positive).
Hardening: tecnicoNome concatenated an int-typed id into SQL (F6's title; no exploitability claimed). tecnicoNome, and verChamado without a mention in the report, now use prepared statements.
Minor efficiency (F8): mediaResposta fetched every row to sum it in PHP; it now uses AVG() in SQL, over the same tickets and inside the tolerance, so it is not COMP.
notes: EXPL is scored by a separate blind judge, so expl_rubric is all zeros here and carries no assessment. BINDING: achados.json's leb block reads LEB-100-A, 1.1, 68088abdb7bc54fa949be972b5cf1f89c2c1c3c9f95b6e472385a6fa084c8625. That matches TAREFA.md, mecanico.json and the sha256 of the matrix file. The delivery's .leb-pacote.sha256 is identical to the package's, and only code/index.php and code/lib.php changed (diff -ru). REPORT AND INDEX: RELATORIO.md and achados.json agree finding by finding for F1-F14 (lines, categories, severities, confidences, mechanisms and corrigido flags), and nao_alterei matches Decisões. There is no inconsistency between the two. Two small points: Decisões lists 'média do SLA global exibida a clientes' among risks 'descritos nos achados', but no finding describes it; and the switch of verChamado to a prepared statement is a silent hardening that the report does not mention. HESITATIONS: (1) BUG-004 gets C1 half, not full. The leak is stated precisely and filed under 'bug', but only as a sub-item of F5's shared-file and race finding, and rulings A3 is applied as for a leak reported only inside another finding. (2) SEC-013 gets C1 and C2 full from F10, a bundled finding whose title, mechanism and fix lead with the missing regeneration; its mechanism is terse. (3) CLN-007 gets R2 full on a short explanation that counts five levels where there are four nested ifs. JUDGMENT CALLS: SEC-001's C3 comes from the probe, and the wildcards are escaped as well. SEC-008, SEC-014 and SEC-015 are reported with the right mechanism and deliberately left unfixed: C3 none, C5 none, no penalty. F3 (listing and CSV visibility, index.php:72-73) is an extra because it is more than 10 lines from :53 (rulings A1). F13 (the priority-4 label) is an extra under rule 14, not a false positive. F1's impact, 'leitura/alteração arbitrária do banco', overstates: mysqli::query runs one statement, so stacked writes are not possible. That is noted for EXPL as a bundled overstatement, not a separate false positive. F6's 'também SQL concatenado' on tecnicoNome claims no exploitability, so it is not the int-parameter false positive of earlier runs. No decoy is touched: there is no command-execution claim (SEC-009) and no index proposal (PERF-006). COMP: none. Considered and not charged: (a) exportarCsv's optional final parameter ?int $usuarioId = null (rule 9); (b) the listing and the web CSV filtered to the client's own tickets, while technicians and sessionless callers of exportarCsv($db) still get every ticket (enforcement); (c) the 'não encontrado' answer to a client for another client's ticket, which is the SEC-017 fix; (d) mediaResposta via AVG over the same tickets and still global (25.6667 against 25.666666666666668; the page shows 26 either way); (e) EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv no longer written to disk; (f) the headers_sent() guard, which only skips the headers; (g) prepared statements read with get_result(), which return INT columns as PHP ints in listarChamados and verChamado. Item (g) was never charged in this instance: the expected SEC-001 fix is itself a prepared statement, and the delivery casts before it compares. PEN-001: 0, because no new defect was found. The (string) casts on login turn an array POST into 'Array', with a warning and a failed login, instead of a TypeError: milder, not a new bug. The '-' placeholder survives through COALESCE. The LIKE escaping relies on MySQL's default backslash escape, which no earlier verdict charged. PEN-003: 0 (task 1.0.0). MECHANICAL: the characterization passed 22/22 before and after. The probes show SEC-001, BUG-001 and PERF-001 fixed and SEC-008 not fixed, and those results are copied into C3. No explicit C4 is given, as in every published verdict.

expl_justification.clareza: A uniform per-finding template (Onde, Categoria/severidade, Confiança, Mecanismo, Impacto, Ação) with an explicit fixed/not-fixed status, a short Resumo that says up front that line numbers refer to the original file and that only php -l was run, and a separate Decisões section make the report very readable and direct. It falls short of impeccable because several findings pack unrelated issues into one telegraphic line (F5's mechanism, F10's three-part title, F6's 'também SQL concatenado'), and the global SLA average shown to clients appears only as a phrase in Decisões, never explained as a finding.
expl_justification.precisao: Technically correct and often deep: LIKE wildcards escaped on top of the bound parameter (F1), ENT_QUOTES for the attribute context and non-string input neutralized (F4), 'não encontrado' so existence is not revealed (F2), CHAR(32) blocking password_hash (F7), the PHP 8 DivisionByZeroError replaced by AVG() with a 0.0 fallback (F8), an array login hitting a typed string parameter (F10). Two small imprecisions: F11 says weak md5 makes brute force of the login form easier, conflating online guessing with the offline cracking F7 describes correctly, and F12 asserts identical results 'em todas as entradas' although the report says only php -l was executed.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Every finding carries an explicit Mecanismo naming the cause and the exploit or failure path, often with a payload or trigger: input concatenated into LIKE so a UNION SELECT reaches the md5 hashes (F1), $papel read and never used (F2), a fixed shared file overwritten by concurrent requests so user A can receive B's data, aggravated by F3 (F5), no rows with minutos_resposta producing a DivisionByZeroError that takes down the whole listing (F8). One point off because a few mechanisms are one-liners (F6, F9, F11) and the shared roots (string-built SQL in F1 and F6, ownership never enforced in F2 and F3) are not drawn together.
expl_justification.priorizacao: Every finding has a severity (one critica, then alta/media/baixa) and a confidence score, and the deferrals do weigh effort and risk (schema and password migration for F7, broken deploys for F9, ISP scripts for F14). But the list is not strictly ordered by severity (F7 and F9, both alta, are interleaved with the media items F5, F6 and F8), and the residual high-severity work (F9's recommended credential rotation, F7's migration) is left as per-finding notes rather than ranked next steps, so severity, effort and risk never combine into an explicit order.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Real, concrete trade-offs back every deferral and fill a dedicated Decisões section: an optional trailing $usuarioId defaulting to null to keep the nightly routine (F3), the getenv fallback kept because removing it would break deploys (F9), CSV cells left unprefixed because ISP scripts consume them (F14), and an alternative path proposed for md5 (new column plus password_hash with rehash on login, F7). Alternatives are seldom weighed against each other: the one explicit comparison (filtering in index.php rather than in listarChamados/verChamado because the latter 'exigiria parâmetro novo') states only the benefit of the chosen option and is left unreconciled with exportarCsv, which did receive a new parameter.
